_notes.usage: Briefing text is assembled: sentence_1 = world_type_hook + req_tier_template (with rank/mission injected). sentence_2 = strat_tone (only at rep < 0). Mission name appended in parentheses.
_notes.req_tier_templates: Keyed by requirement tier. {rank} = role name(s), {mission} = mission name. If no requirement, use 'no_req' key.
_notes.world_type_hooks: 3 options per world type, bot picks one randomly. Used as the opening clause of sentence 1.
_notes.strat_tone: rep_neg1 shown at rep -1, rep_neg2 at rep -2. 2-3 options each, picked randomly.
